mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_surveys WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.question_code, so.option_code FROM user_survey_answers usa JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions q ON q.id = so.question_id WHERE usa.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND q.question_code IN ('PRIORITY_FACTOR', 'OFFICE_ENVIRONMENT')

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, CAST(m.latitude AS DECIMAL(10, 8)) AS latitude, CAST(m.longitude AS DECIMAL(11, 8)) AS longitude FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' ORDER BY r.start_date ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, CAST(COUNT(rw.review_id) AS UNSIGNED) AS review_count, NULL AS noise_level, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rw.atmosphere = 'QUIET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS quiet_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rw.atmosphere = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS open_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rw.atmosphere = 'COLLAB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS collab_review_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bookmarked, (rd.merchant_id IS NOT NULL) AS reserved, rd.reservation_distance FROM merchants m JOIN ( SELECT rp.merchant_id, MIN(ABS(DATEDIFF(r.start_date, #{workationStartDate}))) AS reservation_distance FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY rp.merchant_id ) rd ON rd.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews rw ON rw.merchant_id = m.id AND rw.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, rd.reservation_distance ORDER BY (rd.merchant_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, rd.reservation_distance ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.latitude, m.longitude FROM merchants m WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.region_id = #{regionId}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, CAST(COUNT(r.review_id) AS UNSIGNED) AS review_count, o.noise_level, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'QUIET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS quiet_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS open_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'COLLAB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS collab_review_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.category = 'OFFICE' AND m.region_id = #{regionId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN product_daily_inventories pdi ON pdi.product_id = rp.id WHERE rp.merchant_id = m.id AND pdi.is_available = 1 AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0 AND pdi.inventory_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, o.noise_level ORDER BY m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_requests ( user_id, workation_id, reference_merchant_id, secondary_reference_merchant_id, recommendation_type, reference_type, meal_type, reference_latitude, reference_longitude ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{workationId}, #{referenceMerchantId}, #{secondaryReferenceMerchantId}, #{recommendationType}, #{referenceType}, #{mealType}, #{referenceLatitude}, #{referenceLongitude} )
mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.user_id, rr.workation_id, rr.reference_merchant_id, rr.secondary_reference_merchant_id, rr.recommendation_type AS recommendationType, rr.reference_type AS referenceType, rr.meal_type, rr.reference_latitude, rr.reference_longitude, rr.created_at, m.name AS referenceMerchantName, m2.name AS secondaryReferenceMerchantName FROM recommendation_requests rr LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rr.reference_merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchants m2 ON m2.id = rr.secondary_reference_merchant_id WHERE rr.id = #{recommendationRequestId} AND rr.user_id = #{userId} AND rr.recommendation_type = 'OFFICE' LIMIT 1
